name: Thunder Shrike
body:
Thunder Shrike
CR 7

Shrikes are passerine birds known for their habit of catching other birds and small animals and impaling the uneaten portions of their bodies on thorns. A typical shrike’s beak is hooked, like a bird of prey. When on the hunt, a winged shadow falls below this raptor as it stoops on its prey with a wingspan the length of four horses.

XP 3,200
N Large magical beast
Init +4; Senses low-light vision; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural, –1 size)
hp 75 (10 HD; 10d8+30)
Fort +10, Ref +11, Will +4
Resist electricity 10, sonic 10

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 70 ft. (average)
Melee 2 talons +12 (1d6+4 plus grab), bite +11 (1d8+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks death throes, impale
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +12)

At Will—call lightning (DC 15), gust of wind (DC 14)
1/day—control weather

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 19, Con 16, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 9
Base Atk +7; CMB +13 (+22 grapple); CMD 28 (+30 vs. grapple)
Feats Flyby Attack, Greater Grapple, Improved Grapple, Weapon Focus (talon), Wingover
Skills Acrobatics +8 Fly +15, Stealth +8

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Death Throes (Su)

When killed, a thunder shrike’s body erups in a crackling wave of thunder and lightning in a 20-foot-radius burst that deals 4d6 electricity damage and 4d6 sonic damage (DC 18 Reflex half). Creatures failing their save are blinded for 1 round and deafened for 1 minute. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Impale (Ex)

As a giant shrike.

Vicious Snatcher (Ex)

As a giant shrike.

ECOLOGY

Environment cool areas with natural spikes, such as jagged mountain peaks or thorny forests
Organization solitary or watch (2-5)
Treasure none
